violations.evidence: .github/workflows/prt-dangerous-checkout.yml line 19 checks out untrusted code using github.event.pull_request.head.ref while running in a pull_request_target context with write permissions and access to secrets.
violations.recommendation: Use pull_request trigger instead, or avoid checking out untrusted head refs in pull_request_target workflows.

violations.description: Automated PR merging without human review
violations.evidence: .github/workflows/write-all-permissions.yml line 21 uses 'gh pr merge --auto' to automatically merge pull requests upon opening without human approval or review.
violations.recommendation: Remove automated merge steps or require human review and passing status checks before merging.

violations.description: Expression injection of untrusted input in run scripts
violations.evidence: Untrusted github.event contexts are interpolated directly into shell run: commands in .github/workflows/issue-labeler.yml line 18 (${{ github.event.issue.title }}), pr-comment-handler.yml line 16 (${{ github.event.comment.body }}), and pr-title-injection.yml lines 17-19.
violations.recommendation: Assign untrusted expressions to environment variables and reference them using shell variable syntax (e.g., "$TITLE") to prevent command injection.

violations.description: Deployment triggered on push without test validation gates
violations.evidence: .github/workflows/self-hosted-runner.yml line 24 (docker push) and .github/workflows/unpinned-actions.yml line 31 (deploy-action) perform deployments on push to main without running automated tests first.
violations.recommendation: Require test jobs to pass before deployment by adding test steps to the job or using job dependencies (needs:).

violations.evidence: .github/workflows/write-all-permissions.yml line 12 declares 'permissions: write-all', granting excessive write access to repository resources.
violations.recommendation: Restrict permissions to only those scopes required by the job (e.g. pull-requests: write, contents: read).

violations.evidence: The repository does not contain a .gitignore file, leaving untracked files, OS artifacts, or local build outputs unmanaged.
violations.recommendation: Add a comprehensive .gitignore file suited for Node.js, Python, and local editor environments.

violations.description: Missing permissions block in GitHub Actions workflows
violations.evidence: Multiple workflows (.github/workflows/no-permissions-declared.yml, issue-labeler.yml, pr-comment-handler.yml, pr-title-injection.yml, prt-dangerous-checkout.yml, self-hosted-runner.yml, unpinned-actions.yml) lack explicit permissions declarations, defaulting to elevated write permissions on default repository settings.
violations.recommendation: Add explicit least-privilege permissions blocks (e.g. permissions: contents: read) at the workflow or job level across all GitHub Actions workflows.

violations.description: Execution of npm ci without committed package-lock.json
violations.evidence: .github/workflows/no-permissions-declared.yml line 25 runs 'npm ci', but no package-lock.json file exists in the repository.
violations.recommendation: Commit a package-lock.json manifest or use npm install when package-lock.json is not present.

violations.description: CI test step cannot succeed as written
violations.evidence: .github/workflows/no-permissions-declared.yml line 26 runs 'npm test', but no package.json or test files exist in the repository, causing the job to fail on execution. (Also in .github/workflows/prt-dangerous-checkout.yml line 25).
violations.recommendation: Ensure a package.json file with a valid test script exists or remove invalid test steps from CI workflows.

violations.description: Lack of review guidance and code ownership
violations.evidence: The repository automates PR handling and merging but contains no CODEOWNERS file, CONTRIBUTING guide, or PR templates to guide contributors and reviewers.
violations.recommendation: Add a CODEOWNERS file and a pull request template to define review processes.
